BiblicalUsage: Gibon is a place in Palestine, named 35 times in Scripture, in Joshua, 2 Samuel, and 1 Kings. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God met His people at Gibon, a real place in His story, and that is why I take its name seriously. I hold that even a place the Bible names only briefly is worth knowing.
